title: Help us make VocabX better
text: We collect anonymous usage statistics: which screens you open, how many cards you review and how long you study. We never collect your name, e-mail, IP address or the words you learn.
where: You can change this any time in Settings → Data.
localhostAlert: Note: you opened the app on localhost. Analytics is never sent from here — nothing reaches the spreadsheet.
settingHint: Which screens you open, how many cards you review and how long you study — without your name, e-mail, IP address or the words themselves. Helps make VocabX better.
